Given data: Number of turns ($N$) = $300$, Relative permeability ($\mu_r$) = $900$, Mean circumference ($l$) = $40\text{ mm} = 40 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m}$, Area ($A$) = $50\text{ mm}^2 = 50 \times 10^{-6}\text{ m}^2$, Current ($I$) = $25\text{ A}$.

**(i) Magnetomotive Force (mmf):**
$$\text{mmf} = N \times I = 300 \times 25 = 7500\text{ AT (Ampere-Turns)}$$

**(ii) Reluctance of the ring ($S$):**
$$\mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7}\text{ H/m}$$
$$S = \frac{l}{\mu_0 \mu_r A} = \frac{40 \times 10^{-3}}{(4\pi \times 10^{-7}) \times 900 \times (50 \times 10^{-6})}$$
$$S = \frac{40 \times 10^{-3}}{5.6548 \times 10^{-14}} = 7.07 \times 10^{11}\text{ AT/Wb}$|

**(iii) Flux ($\Phi$):**
$$\Phi = \frac{\text{mmf}}{S} = \frac{7500}{7.07 \times 10^{11}} = 1.06\text{ }\mu\text{Wb}$$
proTip: Always convert dimensions from millimeters (mm) to meters (m) before substituting into magnetic reluctance and flux formulas.
